description: Extrude Mesh with 'Individual' changes face index ordering unexpectedly compared with Individual off.
expected_report: A curve circle (resolution 8) converted to a mesh gives a cylinder; extruding faces with Extrude Mesh and toggling Individual changes the order of face indices (seen in the spreadsheet/viewport index overlay), which the author considers unexpected. Expected: consistent index ordering with Individual on and off.
difficulty: Index numbers in the viewport and spreadsheet are tiny, dark UI, the bug is about data ordering.
